definitions.name: F2C.MED

definitions.name: F2C.MAD
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX F2C.MED 'MM' BIND MX MM SUB 'MD' BIND MD MD -1 MUL MAX F2C.MED
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of exact numbers
